description: How entities' states changed over a window, from the recorder: for each entity its changes oldest first (the first is the state when the window opened), the newest limit of them. Default the last 24 hours; at most 31 days, and only as far back as the recorder keeps (10 days unless configured otherwise).

attributes.description: Include each change's attributes too (much larger).

end.description: Where it ends; default now, with its offset: 2026-03-01T18:00:00+02:00 or 2026-03-01T16:00:00Z. health gives the instance's time zone.

hours.description: Instead of start: this many hours before end (default 24).

limit.description: At most this many changes per entity, the newest (1-1000).

start.description: Where the window starts; default the last `hours` before end, with its offset: 2026-03-01T18:00:00+02:00 or 2026-03-01T16:00:00Z. health gives the instance's time zone.

name: history
title: State history
